findings.highlight: her shoulders are moving up and down
findings.evidenceJa: 肩がわずかに上下している
findings.governingReading: Her shoulders are rising and falling slightly, as though she ran there.
findings.explanation: The English removes the restrained degree of Rin’s exertion.

findings.highlight: I’ll train you as your cooperator
findings.evidenceJa: 仲間同士、きっかり鍛えてあげる
findings.governingReading: As allies, Rin will train Shirou thoroughly and properly.
findings.explanation: “Cooperator” is non-English and weakens Rin’s framing of them as comrades.

findings.evidenceJa: 桜の家よりもっと高い位置にある
findings.governingReading: The Tohsaka house stands at an even higher elevation than Sakura’s house.
findings.explanation: The English turns vertical comparison into an ambiguous location beyond Sakura’s house.

findings.highlight: this house feels more like a Western mansion
findings.evidenceJa: いかにも洋館って感じで見惚れてしまう
findings.governingReading: It so perfectly feels like a Western mansion that Shirou finds himself captivated.
findings.explanation: The English removes Shirou’s involuntary admiration of Rin’s home.

findings.evidenceJa: なんとなく威圧されただけだ
findings.governingReading: He merely felt somehow intimidated or overawed.
findings.explanation: Atmospheric intimidation becomes actual coercion by an agent.

findings.highlight: someone who’s ignorant of magical energy like you
findings.evidenceJa: 魔力の気配に疎い貴方
findings.governingReading: Even Shirou, insensitive to the presence of magical energy, can perceive the house’s coldness.
findings.explanation: Rin’s technical comment about poor sensitivity becomes a broader insult to Shirou’s knowledge.

findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂はずんずんと進んでいく
findings.governingReading: Tohsaka strides briskly onward.
findings.explanation: The English sends Rin inside even though the next page still places her at the entrance beckoning Shirou.

findings.highlight: It’s not because of the atmosphere that I’m hesitating
findings.evidenceJa: 尻込みしてるのは雰囲気だけじゃない
findings.governingReading: The atmosphere is not the only reason Shirou is hanging back.
findings.explanation: The English excludes the atmosphere as a cause instead of retaining it alongside his romantic nervousness.

findings.evidenceJa: そんなものは二の次なのだ
findings.governingReading: The cold atmosphere is a secondary concern.
findings.explanation: The English dismisses a real but lesser concern entirely.

findings.highlight: If I’m lucky, she’ll just laugh
findings.evidenceJa: 笑われるのが関の山
findings.governingReading: At best—or in all likelihood—Rin would only laugh at him.
findings.explanation: The English makes laughter a fortunate outcome rather than Shirou’s expected ceiling for being understood.

findings.highlight: I wish she’d think of me as a boy her age
findings.evidenceJa: 同い年の異性同士なのだと、考慮してくれないものか
findings.governingReading: He wishes Rin would consider that they are opposite-sex peers of the same age.
findings.explanation: The English makes Shirou ask Rin to recognize his identity as a boy, losing the mutual social and romantic situation.

findings.evidenceJa: [ruby text=キシュア char=3]大師父の[ruby text=めのう char=2]瑪瑙
findings.governingReading: the Great Teacher’s agate, read as Kischur and agate
findings.explanation: The English keeps the ruby name but removes Kischur’s title and Rin’s relation to him.

findings.evidenceJa: 二、三輪持ってきて
findings.governingReading: bring up two or three blossoms
findings.explanation: The English removes the exact small quantity and floral counter from Rin’s instruction.

findings.evidenceJa: 君を出し抜く度胸
findings.governingReading: the nerve to outwit or get the better of Rin
findings.explanation: Archer’s taunt about Shirou’s ability to outmaneuver Rin becomes a moral suspicion of betrayal.

findings.highlight: I didn’t feel much magical energy from him
findings.evidenceJa: 全然感じられなかった
findings.governingReading: Shirou could not sense any of Archer’s otherwise powerful magical energy.
findings.explanation: The English changes complete concealment in spirit form into merely reduced output.

findings.evidenceJa: 外部への魔力遮断
findings.governingReading: blocking magical energy from escaping to the outside
findings.explanation: The English’s “shut in” is nonidiomatic and obscures the workshop barrier’s outward-leakage function.

findings.highlight: it takes nothing to hide magical energy
findings.evidenceJa: 魔力を隠すだけならどうとでもなる
findings.governingReading: If all one needs is to conceal magical energy, there are any number of ways to manage it.
findings.explanation: The English changes availability of methods into a claim that concealment requires no effort.

findings.evidenceJa: 難しい顔で
findings.governingReading: with a troubled or intent expression
findings.explanation: The English applies “difficult” to Rin’s face in an unnatural, context-poor way.

findings.evidenceJa: [ruby text=あ char=2]アー[r][ruby text=いつ char=3]チャー
findings.governingReading: Rin addresses Archer in the written text while the ruby reads aitsu, “that guy.”
findings.explanation: The English removes Rin’s layered half-address, half-reference to Archer and supplies a plain pronoun.

findings.evidenceJa: 大師父の宝石
findings.governingReading: the Great Teacher’s jewels
findings.explanation: The English collapses Rin’s title for Kischur into “my master,” changing the stated relationship and rank.

findings.evidenceJa: 凄いものが目に入った
findings.governingReading: Something striking or remarkable catches Shirou’s eye.
findings.explanation: The English removes the force of the discovery that interrupts his idle inspection.

findings.highlight: It’s nothing much, so I hesitate
findings.evidenceJa: どうでもいい違いなので口にするのが[ruby text=はばか]憚られた
findings.governingReading: Because the difference is so trivial, Shirou hesitates to put it into words.
findings.explanation: The English omits that Shirou specifically hesitates to voice the observation and why doing so feels improper.

findings.evidenceJa: 同じのつけてると思う
findings.governingReading: keep wearing the same hair fastener
findings.explanation: The English can mean retaining possession, weakening Rin’s rhetorical point about wearing one accessory for more than a decade.

findings.highlight: It’s the last resort for female magi
findings.evidenceJa: 女の魔術師にとって髪は最後の切り札でしょ
findings.governingReading: For a female magus, her hair is a final trump card.
findings.explanation: The pronoun makes ribbons or hair fasteners the last resort and drops hair as the magical reserve itself.

findings.highlight: keep our reserve magical energy from our hair
findings.evidenceJa: 髪だけでも予備魔力を蓄えておかないと
findings.governingReading: at least store reserve magical energy in the hair
findings.explanation: The English reverses the hair’s role from storage location to apparent source of the energy.
